description: Baseline metric thresholds for the full 221-case eval (propose/confirm booking architecture; typed search_rooms tool, returning 4 rooms by default and up to 15 on request via its limit argument), including the fifteen attribute-search cases case_0207 to case_0221. Set from the mean of three runs, as was the earlier 206-case baseline, since single-run variance on the judge-scored metrics is large. strict=true metrics require every individual case score to equal 1.0; strict=false metrics require the mean across cases to be >= min_allowed. Judge and Ragas LLM is gemini-3.5-flash-lite (gemini-2.5-flash was deprecated for this account); booking.llm.reasoning_effort is medium. Ragas context precision uses the hotel-tuned prompt in eval/evaluators/_rag_prompts.py, which scores a chunk as useful when it answers any one clause of a multi-part question, and skips turns whose reference is only the 'nothing matched' sentinel ([ragas].no_match_reference) because a contentless refusal gives the judge nothing to score against. Ragas calls retry transient Gemini errors, and a failed call is never scored as 0.0. These are the first runs scored with the two-sided booking outcome check: a write that succeeds on a turn labeled expected_success false now fails the turn, as does any propose_* call on a turn labeled expect_no_write. 37 turns were relabeled from false to true after checking each against a freshly reset branch; the fifteen attribute-search cases and case_0169's search-only last turn carry expect_no_write instead of an outcome label. booking_no_unexpected_failure_rate was 1.0 in all three runs, over 235 to 246 scored turns. booking_tool_errors is 0.9978 because case_0212's first search in one run used a date outside the bookable range before retrying with 2025. route_accuracy is 0.9985 because case_0205's demand for a confirmation number was refused rather than routed to booking in one run, which is safe but counts as a misroute. info_expected_filters_pass_rate is 0.9981 because case_0005's 'I only have 20-minute' turn was again read as an exact duration in one run. booking_expected_search_pass_rate is averaged over the fifteen labeled cases, and every one passed in all three runs; min_allowed 0.85 allows about two missed cases. booking_no_unbacked_success_claims stays at 1.0; the evaluator accepts a confirm made on the same turn or any earlier turn as backing for a success claim.
